about: The bleep's loudness, shared by the app and the web app (docs/shared-code.md): each bleep's beep follows the loudness of the speech it replaces. level = clamp(RMS of the speech over the bleep and BLEEP_WINDOW_S either side * BLEEP_SPEECH_GAIN, BLEEP_MIN_LEVEL, BLEEP_MAX_LEVEL), as the beep's peak amplitude (VoiceDsp / BleepLevel.kt, lib/voice.ts bleepLevel).

consts.name: BLEEP_WINDOW_S
consts.doc: Seconds of the speech either side of the bleep that are measured with it.

consts.name: BLEEP_SPEECH_GAIN
consts.doc: The beep's peak amplitude per unit of the speech's RMS: 1.0 is a sine whose RMS is 3 dB under the speech's.

consts.name: BLEEP_MIN_LEVEL
consts.doc: The quietest beep (peak, 1 = full scale): a bleep over near silence is still heard.

consts.name: BLEEP_MAX_LEVEL
consts.doc: The loudest beep (peak): the fixed level it was before it followed the speech. Never near clipping.

consts.name: BLEEP_FALLBACK_LEVEL
consts.doc: The beep when the speech's loudness is not known (the app before the sound is decoded).
